errors.wrong: Hook dilemma asks "Which of these texts is a real, complete sentence?" but option A is a fragment and option B ("The buzzer beat us by half a second, we lost.") is a comma splice, so neither is complete.
errors.correct: Exactly one option must be complete: make option B a correct compound sentence ("..., and we lost.").

errors.wrong: Error-highlighter marks "Because" in "Because the gym was booked, practice was moved." as a fragment starter, but that sentence is a correct complex sentence.
errors.correct: Make the first sentence a real fragment ("Because the gym was booked. Practice was moved.") so "Because" is truly the fragment starter.

errors.wrong: Trap card keys "Complete sentence" for "The alarm didn't go off because the power had gone out overnight, we overslept by an hour.", which is a comma splice.
errors.correct: Make the sentence the one its reasoning describes ("The alarm didn't go off because the power had gone out overnight."), which is complete, and make the trap labels match.
